_comment: Zenodo deposition metadata for the record that carries the landmark annotations and the tables that describe the study: which subject is in which split, what each class integer means, and the out-of-domain cohort. Paste these fields into the upload form. The code never downloads from this record -- it is what a reader needs to redo the experiments. The description Zenodo shows is zenodo/annotations.md, uploaded as a file too, so there is deliberately no "description" field here.
title: Vox2SegLAM 1.0.0: landmark annotations, split assignment and label tables
notes: The MRI volumes are not redistributed here. The HOA subjects come from the Human Connectome Project under its data use terms; the out-of-domain scans are on OpenNeuro (ds000115, ds003499, ds003568, ds003763, ds006067). Every table names its subjects so the images can be fetched from the source.
